references.text: Jesus makes a similar assurance that this generation will not pass away before all these things have happened, in the Gospel of Matthew.
Luke gives a parallel statement from Jesus that this generation will not pass away until everything is fulfilled.

Isaiah speaks of the heavens vanishing like smoke, the earth wearing out like a garment, and its inhabitants dying in the same way, but God's salvation shall last forever, and His righteousness shall never end. This can be seen as an earlier reference to the transience of the world and God's eternal word.
In the book of Daniel there is a vision of the Son of Man coming with the clouds, a kingdom that will never pass away. This can be seen in connection with Jesus' talk about events of the end times.
